photos.caption: NASA's video, clock 14:20:50
photos.how: Frame from NASA's video at 889 s; on-screen clock 04/06/13 14:20:50, wanted 14:20:50 (within 20 s; the matrix time plus one day). NASA's as-run matrix gives this test's start as '13-095:  14:20ish?' on 2013-04-05 (`as run matrix!B89`), read as 2013-04-05 14:20. The video's on-screen clock reads one day later than the matrix on every day both cover, the same kind of offset NASA states for this clock on BASS-II, so the clock was searched for 2013-04-05 plus one day, 14:20: it was found 839 s into this video, and in no other video.
